Carmen Ortiz.description: conversing about Carmen Ortiz and Yuriko Yamamoto discussing their respective projects, training sessions, and plans to meet up for drinks at The Rose and Crown after work. @ <persona> Yuriko Yamamoto
chat: Yuriko Yamamoto
Hi Carmen, I just wanted to say that your demonstration was really helpful. It looks like you're doing a great job engaging with customers today.
Carmen Ortiz
Thanks, Yuriko! It's nice to know people are finding it helpful. How’s the training session going?
Yuriko Yamamoto
It’s going well, thanks for asking. I just hope to apply what we’re learning effectively in my work. Speaking of which, how’s your web series coming along?
Carmen Ortiz

It’s coming along nicely! Francisco has been very supportive. I’m excited to highlight our community spirit and local businesses in the series. How about we catch up over some drinks at The Rose and Crown after your training session?
Yuriko Yamamoto
That sounds like a great idea, Carmen. I look forward to sampling those Valentine’s cocktails infused with rose petals.
Carmen Ortiz
Perfect! Let’s meet there around 2:30 then. I need to grab a quick bite at home first, but I’ll be right over after my shift ends.
Yuriko Yamamoto
Sounds good, I’ll see you there. Have a nice dinner at home!
Carmen Ortiz
Thanks, Yuriko! See you at The Rose and Crown then.
Yuriko Yamamoto
That works for me. Enjoy your dinner, Carmen!
Carmen Ortiz
Thanks again for your support and encouragement during the training session, Yuriko. See you later!
